column1: Review

Kunal Khemu directorial debut is outstanding. This film made my day specially the cast involve in it is so damn good. Directing the 1st film is not an easy job and then to if it's a comedy genre but Kunal Khemu deserves all applause for a fun and super direction done by him.Now talking about the storyline simple friend group goa trip story with best situational comedy perform by the actors specially Pratik, Divyendu & Avinash just nailed their performance throughout the film.Chemistry between these 3 is fun to watch and kinda hooked you up in the film. Yes there is flaws in the script because screenplay could've been little tighter and little bit of pacing issues but comedy will entertain you a lot specially in the 1st half is too good.Cinematography is good specially Goa location is fun to watch. Supporting cast are average because isn't much to do in the film except for the 3 leads.Dialogues in the comedy scenes is good and supports the scenes well yet songs are unnecessary in the film.Overall A good time pass film with enjoyable comedy and good performance by the lead cast....

Went to watch the movie with minimal expectations and must say that the movie surprised me positively.Story idea about 3 boys finally going to Goa after years of failed planning in itself is good enough. The execution of the idea is also at par. Dialogues, situations created definitely evoke laughter every now and then. Even in serious situations, we the audience, enjoy. The movie definitely has certain World cinema Neo Noir touch.The characters speak in a very natural and daily routine kind of dialogues which sound funny and logical as well.3 of the actors have done fantastic job starting from Pratik Gandhi who steals the show with his pre and post drugs antiques. Divyendu acts very well and has funny one liners too that generates laughter. Avinash Tiwary plays his part of a no non sense guy quite well. Chhaya Kadam and Upendra limaye are the icing on the cake. Norah Fatehi plays her part of an eye candy pretty well. Rest of the supporting actors especially the one playing the can driver have played their part superbly.Direction is very good, however placement of songs is very bad at almost every place. Screenplay could have been more crisp, to give much better pace to the movie.No unnecessary adult scenes or double meaning jokes have been added, which makes the effort of writing and direction by Kunal Keu very commendable.Must watch with your friends and family at theatre near you.

People born in the late 1990s, particularly those who grew up watching comedies from the 2000s, may experience nostalgia for their younger years.Credit goes to none other than Mr. Kemmu, the writer-director, for reinvigorating "comedy of errors" genre, which had been lacking its trademark in recent years."Madgaon Express" might not have reached its peak but it offered enough quirk and entertainment for its viewers.The characters were eccentric, the punchlines hit the mark, and most importantly, the actors appeared to be enjoying themselves, especially, Pratik Gandhi in his 'Rowdy' persona, so ridiculous yet so much fun.

First of all, it feels like some one told Kunal Khemmu sir that do whatever the hell u want to , people should laugh, and he played his magic , the dialogues, the cinematography, the editing of the movie is at its peak, how the story goes ahead , the second half made us hold our breaths as the scenes went past , and made us brace ourselves to our seats for the climax, one thing I would like to mention is first part could have been more exciting and intriguing like the second interval but post the break , it's just a rollercoaster, the scenes the lines the action , he never missed to add the comic to every scene , like in one scene if something is happening to the subjects the background is something which our eyes will go and we will like what is happening, this is a must view for the people who missed comedy (I am sure everyone did and we got our old comedy back ) no cuss words nothing pure comedy , just wow.

Bulletpoint review:This comedy of errors by writer-director Kunal Khemu is good fun while it lasts. His 2-minute cameo is fun too.Pratik Gandhi is the clear standout here. The man holds immense potential as a performer. Divyendu is good when he sticks to comedy (which is about 80% of his screentime). Avinash Tiwary is serviceable.Seeing Nora Fatehi in a non-item-dancer capacity is a pleasant surprise.The songs are all of the "loo break" variety.The antagonists (played by Upendra Limaye & Chhaya Kadam) are hilariously solid. The actors contribute more than what the screenplay has for them.Did NOT enjoy the whole "dress up as women" angle for the leads to infiltrate the Kombdi hideout.Most of the situational humour (keeping the previous point aside) and the dudes' bromistry work.

I mean it when I say this. Its"A Rib-Tickling Ride!"Madgaon Express" is a rib-tickling ride filled with laughter and entertainment. Kunal Khemu's directorial debut is a breath of fresh air in the comedy genre, offering a delightful mix of humor and heartwarming moments. This film is a perfect blend of quirky characters, witty dialogues, and hilarious situations that will leave you in splits. Kunal Khemu's direction is commendable, making this journey an unforgettable one for the audience. The ensemble cast delivers stellar performances, making this film a must-watch for comedy lovers. In the present sea of thrillers , murder mysteries and voyeuristic drama - the film feels like a breadth of fresh air. After watching this you will realize that this is the kind of movie we were waiting for since very long.

The movie is not like a lot of laughter comedy scenes but still the pace, screenplay and some really good comedy moments are great which makes it overall a good movie to watch.Allnactors have done the great job for their roles.Some twists are also good to see.Music is fine but don't why there are songs which really does not required is been fit in the story. It some how slows down the pace a bit of the movie.But overall screenplay looks good with a nice story and some comedy punches too.After a long time good clean comedy is there.Background score is good and lifts up the scenes at many places.

Laugh-out-loud hilarious from start to finish, this comedy movie is a must-watch for anyone. All the characters have played very nicely and worth watching. Well done everyone and well directed by Kunal. This comedy gem delivers a perfect blend of humor and heart, leaving audiences in stitches while also touching their emotions. The characters are endearing, the jokes are cleverly crafted, and the comedic situations are both outrageous and relatable. With its infectious energy and charm, this movie is a feel-good escape that will have you laughing until your sides ache. Whether you're watching alone or with friends, it's guaranteed to brighten your day and leave you wanting more. Don't miss out on the joyous experience of this comedic masterpiece!

Proud of kunal khemu that he finally did something big with his comic talent. Movie is good.Some jokes were very very good, they landed beautifully and made me laugh loudly. Many other ones made me smile.Acting wise for me best was obviosly munna bhaya first then pratik gandhi and then tiwari ji. Nora was also nice. Both villains were good and comedic.Production was good, and story takes ample time to settle, no rush on that front.Goa was also good though nothing much happened outside. Not funny song was good.Overall it is a good bollywood comedy movie after a long time. Please watch and apprecisate it. We want more from khemu now.

The best way to enjoy this movie is to go in without having watched the trailer (which contains a lot of spoilers and showcased most of it's best moments), or any promotional content and watch it with absolutely zero expectations. The rave reviews raise the bar too high and subconsciously expects this to be on par with a Dil Chahta Hai, Go Goa Gone and Hera Pheri, which this certainly isn't.The actors are flawless however the screenplay and dialogues was a big let down.Madgaon Express would probably be recieved better once it releases on the OTT platform. In my opinion, it doesn't merit a definitive theatrical experience for your money's worth.

This movie deserves all the love it can get. Fantastic characters, great story and direction and brilliant acting. Divyenndu steals the show with his unbelievable timing and conviction, and the rest of the cast fits around him beautifully. Kunal Kemmu, take a bow!Quite obviously inspired by The Hangover, the story is really well put together to create many many moments of legit situational comedy, which we haven't seen in some time. Go watch with the same friends you watched Dil Chahta Hai with.From the way they ended it, it felt like they will be tempted to do a sequel, and to that I say bring it on!

Maybe the reviews and feedback for the movie from everyone made me look forward to watching this, but the experience I has was very below par.To start with the writing is very weak - there are instances where over the top or even total nonsensical events are forced just to reach the desired event in the movie. I mean who would chokeslam their own friend (who has several medical conditions) on a wooden bed?The genre is drama and comedy but takes dark turn for no valid reason whatsoever. Most of it focussed on one character which failed to invoke any laughter.The only moment worth watching, if at all was when the timid friend becomes fearless temporarily due to cocaine. But again, this never gets converted into anything real.I would say, it's totally overhyped and if you have seen the trailer, that's enough. Doesn't have much to offer.

"Madgaon Express" takes audiences on a hilarious journey filled with laughter, wit, and heartwarming moments. Kunal Khemu's directorial debut shines as he skillfully navigates a diverse ensemble cast through a series of comedic escapades on a train journey. Pure comedy without double meaning dialogues, so when you watch with your whole family you won't have to look somewhere else because this just the movie everyone were looking for their family time entertainment. The film's clever screenplay, coupled with standout performances from Divyenndu, Pratik Gandhi, and Nora Fatehi, creates a delightful cinematic experience that will leave viewers smiling from start to finish. A mass masala and entertainment film.

This movie is enjoyable enough for a single viewing, but it doesn't offer the kind of experience that would make you want to watch it again.The plot follows a familiar formula seen in many Indian comedy films. It revolves around a group of friends who set out to have a fun time but end up entangled with local gangs, putting their lives in danger. This leads to a series of comedic mishaps as they try to save themselves. While the storyline has its entertaining moments, it doesn't bring anything new to the table and follows a predictable trajectory typical of Bollywood comedies.The film's reliance on a tried-and-true formula means it lacks the freshness and originality that could make it stand out in the crowded landscape of Indian cinema. The comedic situations, while amusing, are somewhat clichéd and expected.In my opinion, Bollywood should explore more innovative and creative approaches to comedy. A great example of this is the film "The Terminal," which showcases a unique blend of humor and heart. It's a reminder that experimenting with different storytelling techniques and comedic styles can lead to more memorable and impactful films.In conclusion, this movie is a good choice if you're looking for some light entertainment and don't mind the repetitive plot elements. However, if you're seeking something new and refreshing, it might fall short of your expectations.

This train chugs along merrily raising laughs and also goes into rollercoaster mode for some time. It could be called Mad express. The story is about three school mates who dream of going to Goa on a holiday but it works out only when they have grown up. Two of them Pratik Gandhi and Avinash Tiwary are now settled abroad but Divyendu Sharma the third friend is struggling to make ends meet in Mumbai. Divyendu pretends to be rich and organizes the trip to Goa from Mumbai. All three then set off on a holiday but fate has other plans for them. Pratik's bag gets exchanged with a gangster's bag, unknown to them their hotel room has drugs, they are caught by the gangsters, they nearly get killed while escaping and go through many misadventures.Debutant director Kunal Kennu ( the actor) has attempted to make a full length rib tickling comedy and has done a good job. The fast moving narrative has many comic situations to keep the audience absorbed. All characters have been given a quirky and eccentric colour to produce gags and humour. There are some witty one liners, crazy goings on, madness, chaos, comedy of errors etc. There is glamour in the form of Nora Fatehi which works. The madness continues for 2 hour 23 minutes and there is no option but to sit back and enjoy. In addition to amusing comedy by the three main actors, some hilarious comedy is provided by Upendra Limaye as a blundering don. Watch him do a head stand to "speak face to face" with the captives hanging upside down. Chaya Kadam also has done good comedy. Intermittently the movie starts dragging when the characters start getting serious and utter long winded dialogue to propel the story forward. The movie has excellent music, camera work and editing.

From Divyenndu's comic timing to Nora Fatehi's charismatic presence, the chemistry among the cast members is palpable. The humor is both witty and relatable, making "Madgaon Express" a must-watch for anyone in need of a good laugh. The story revolves around a diverse group of characters who find themselves on a train journey filled with hilarious twists and turns. The ensemble castdelivers stellar performances that keep the audience engaged and entertained throughout. One of the film's strengths lies in its witty and relatable screenplay, which seamlessly blends humor with heartfelt moments. Kunal Khemu's direction shines as he skillfully navigates between comedy and emotions, creating a balanced and engaging cinematic experience.

"Madgaon Express" strikes the perfect balance between comedy gold and heartfelt moments, making it a must-watch for audiences craving a dose of laughter and warmth. This movie reminds us of the level of entertainment we had while watching Go Goa Gone, Dhol, Dhamal. Definitely we can add this to the collection of all time entertainment. Kunal Khemu's directorial debut showcases a refreshing take on comedy, with a narrative that resonates on an emotional level. Divyenndu, Pratik Gandhi, Avinash Tiwary, and Nora Fatehi deliver impeccable performances, infusing the film with energy and charm. After ages, one real comedy which made me feel so light , amazing direction and natural performance, loved the movie.

The film was truly underwhelming, failing to deliver on its promise of entertainment. Most of the jokes fell flat, lacking the wit and humor expected from a comedy. The storyline was uninspired and lacked depth, making it difficult to engage with the characters or the plot. It's difficult to understand how some viewers are awarding it five stars and drawing comparisons to iconic films like "Dil Chahta Hai" and "3 Idiots." In my opinion, it was a regrettable experience that simply doesn't measure up to the standards set by those classics. Save your time and money for something more worthwhile..

Madgaon express ......well truly the best comedy movie in a span of 3-4 years which makes you laugh out loud. Its certainly at the scale of movies like Dil chahta hai or phir Hera pheri .......well no comparison with the legendary movies but madgaon express truly deserves a recognition like these movies.The storyline is itself hilarious and doesn't bore you for a single minute and both the halves of the film are equally funny. Dibyendu was too good in the series in the first half as well the second but pratik Gandhi oh man....too good after the drug scene. Charactera of Mendoza and kanchan kombdi were excellent and too funny. Nora fatehi and remo were also surprisingly impressive. Last but not the least Avinash tiwary ...he was also damn funny. Overall a very humours film one should definitely try.

Madgaon Express is not just a movie, it's a whirlwind of madness that takes you on a thrilling journey through the chaotic yet amusing world of drugs, the mafia, and the police. Directed by Kunal Kemmu, this film is a mass entertainer that promises non-stop fun for the entire family. His direction deserves applause for keeping the film's energy levels high and ensuring that the laughter never fades away.The film's plot revolves around our protagonists getting entangled in a web of drugs, mafia, and law enforcement, setting the stage for a series of hilarious escapades. The screenplay is peppered with witty dialogues that keep the audience in splits throughout the film. There's never a dull moment as the narrative unfolds with one uproarious scene after another.The stellar cast, led by Divyenndu, Pratik Gandhi, Avinash Tiwary, Upendra Limaye, and Chhaya Kadam, delivers brilliant performances. However, Nora Fatehi remains merely an eye candy, while Remo D'Souza's supporting role adds a decent touch to the ensemble. This film will leave you with a smile on your face and a desire to hop aboard the "Madgaon Express" once again.Direction 3.5/5
Acting 3.5/5
Comedy 4/5
Story 3/5
Screenplay 3.5/5.

One of the producer of this movies is Farhan Akhtar.. Who made GOA a dream when we were teenagers. The buzzing background music of Dil Chahta hey will not let you forget that these three guys are heavily inspired by that. From the travel movie it transposes into the HANGOVER zone . Although sometimes over the board the movie doesn't leave its comedic zone which is one of the greatest success of this movie. The reminiscence of hangover you can see in few scenes where the bloods have been shed in the cocaine business and when you meet gangsters. Dibyenshu post Mirzapur shines in this DODO role and the dialogues are so spot on. At the end it ends up with a possibility of sequel . I will buy that ticket as well.
